BUYING & PROJECT PLANNING

Game-Day Drinkware Checklist: Cups, Sleeves and Service Tools

Confirm venue container rules, quantities and distribution before choosing branded drinkware.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →

Check the venue before the catalogue

Ask the organizer about permitted containers, capacity, access points and cleanup. A stadium-style or baseball-bat shape does not establish venue approval.

Build a role-based list

Separate guest cups and fitted sleeves from shared openers, trays and ice-service tools. Specify quantities for each role instead of multiplying every item by the guest count.

Make the delivery brief comparable

Provide model counts, artwork versions, packing and the arrival destination. Agree production completion and transit assumptions separately, without treating an event date as an automatic rush-service guarantee.

Before Sending the Enquiry

Review itemWhat to send
Model & portionSKU, vessel shape and required capacity option.
Use & configurationBeverage, temperature conditions, lid, straw or other components.
Artwork & deliveryDesign quantities, decoration position, packing, destination and arrival date.
